topic: Make-up air: the half of extraction nobody plans

slides.headline: A fan cannot pull air out of a sealed box.
slides.subline: Every bit of air leaving needs a way back in.

slides.title: Why the kitchen fights the fan
slides.intro: Extraction only works when replacement air can get in.

items.title: Closed doors
items.text: A sealed room starves the fan and starves the flame.

items.title: Smoke at head height
items.text: No make-up air, and the fumes have nowhere to go but the room.

items.title: Pressure
items.text: A kitchen under negative pressure pulls air from drains and dining rooms.

slides.note_text: Doors that slam, smells that travel, a fan that sounds strained.

slides.title: Where replacement air comes from
slides.intro: It has to be planned, not left to an open window.

items.title: Transfer grilles
items.text: A controlled path from the rest of the building into the kitchen.

items.title: Dedicated supply
items.text: Filtered air delivered to the cooking line, heated or cooled if needed.

items.title: Commissioning
items.text: Balance the room once, then check it again after any fit-out change.

slides.note_title: Not a hole in a wall
slides.note_text: Uncontrolled air brings dust, heat and insects with it.

slides.headline: Your exhaust is only as good as the air coming back in.
slides.subline: We check both sides before recommending a bigger fan.

caption_en:
A kitchen exhaust is half of a pair. The fan pulls air out, and something has to replace it.

When replacement air is missing, the symptoms look like fan problems. Doors are hard to open. Smoke hangs at head height. The flame pulls away from the burner. Grease and smells drift into the dining room instead of leaving the building.

The usual mistake is to fit a bigger fan. That makes the pressure worse. The right fix is a planned path for incoming air, sized to what the hood extracts.

عندما يغيب هواء التعويض، تظهر الأعراض وكأنها مشكلة مروحة. أبواب يصعب فتحها، ودخان يبقى عند مستوى الرأس، ولهب ينفصل عن الموقد، ودهون وروائح تنتقل إلى صالة الطعام بدل أن تخرج من المبنى.
